meta.description: Your entire operational life, managed by AI

hero.subtext: Personal todos, team projects, CI/CD pipelines, bug tracking, monitoring, and OKR-driven life planning — unified in one AI-native surface. Agents aren't assistants. They're co-workers.

tagline: Think: Notion + Linear + Todoist + StatusPage + Wiki — but the AI is a co-worker, not a feature.

todayView.title: Unified Today View
todayView.description: Personal todos, team tasks, deploys, alerts, habits, and calendar — all in one morning planning surface. No more 5-tab juggling.

methodology.title: Every Methodology
methodology.description: Scrum, kanban, waterfall, GTD, or your own hybrid. Methodology is a view, not a cage. Switch without migrating data.

agents.title: Agents as Team Members
agents.description: AI agents aren't tools — they're colleagues with roles, permissions, and accountability. PM, Triage, Coder, Monitor, and more.

ops.title: Built-in Ops
ops.description: CI/CD pipeline visibility, uptime monitoring, incident management, deploy tracking, and SLO budgets — without leaving your PM tool.

rag.title: RAG Context Engine
rag.description: Every task, doc, deploy, and alert feeds a unified knowledge graph. Agents and humans get full situational awareness — automatically.

okrs.title: Life + Work OKRs
okrs.description: Personal goals tracked with the same rigor as professional KRs. Exercise streaks, reading lists, and savings goals — alongside sprint velocity.

agentRoles.heading: Your virtual team, ready to work
agentRoles.subtext: Configure each agent's autonomy — from "inform me" to "handle it completely."
